pois.label: Sabatier 反应柱
pois.detail: 分段固定床甲烷化反应器：两段 Ru/Al₂O₃ 催化剂床、床间冷却盘管、底部进料预热回热器，三道法兰对应床段、可整段抽换催化剂。CO₂ 与电解回氢在 ~350 °C 反应生成甲烷和水，产物经冷凝分水后甲烷入罐。剖切侧可见两段深色催化剂床与铜色盘管。
pois.detail_en: A staged fixed-bed methanation reactor: two Ru/Al2O3 catalyst beds, cooling coils between them, and a feed-preheat recuperator at the base. Three flanges match the bed sections so a whole bed of catalyst can be swapped out. CO2 and recycled electrolysis hydrogen react at around 350 C to methane and water; the product is condensed, the water separated, and the methane sent to the tanks. The cutaway side shows both dark catalyst beds and the copper coils.

specs.超压泄放: 安全阀+爆破片 → 火炬

specs_en.Overpressure relief: safety valve + rupture disc to the flare

pois.sim: 产能链锚点：480 sol 无人期加满 MAV 30 t 推进剂 → LCH₄ 6.5 t ÷ 480 sol = 13.5 kg/sol ≈ 0.55 kg/h（EQUIPMENT.md §1）
pois.sim_en: Capacity anchor: filling the MAV with 30 t of propellant during the 480-sol uncrewed campaign needs 6.5 t of LCH4, i.e. 6.5 t / 480 sol = 13.5 kg/sol = about 0.55 kg/h (EQUIPMENT.md section 1).
physics: CO₂ + 4H₂ → CH₄ + 2H₂O，ΔH ≈ −165 kJ/mol：强放热，不做床间冷却催化剂会过热烧结失活——分段床+盘管的存在理由
放热经底部回热器预热进料，自热平衡后仅启动时需要电加热
physics_en: CO2 + 4 H2 -> CH4 + 2 H2O, dH = about -165 kJ/mol: strongly exothermic. Without inter-bed cooling the catalyst overheats, sinters and deactivates - which is exactly why the bed is staged and coiled.
That reaction heat is recuperated at the base to preheat the feed, so once the column is self-sustaining, electrical heating is only needed at start-up.

pois.label: CO₂ 吸入·过滤·压缩
pois.detail: 两级除尘（旋风+HEPA 双滤箱）串两级涡旋压缩机（MOXIE 谱系）+ 级间冷却器。火星大气 95% 是 CO₂，但总压只有 ~600 Pa——同样质量的气体占地球百倍体积，连续大流量吸气使压缩机成为全厂关键设备。剖切舱内可见两级涡旋盘与级间冷却器。
pois.detail_en: Two stages of dust removal (cyclone plus twin HEPA boxes) feeding two scroll compressor stages of the MOXIE lineage with an intercooler. The Martian atmosphere is 95% CO2, but its total pressure is only about 600 Pa - the same mass of gas occupies a hundred times the volume it would on Earth, so continuous high-volume intake makes the compressor the critical machine of the whole plant. The cutaway shows both scroll sets and the intercooler.

specs.压缩方案: 两级涡旋 + 级间冷却
specs.除尘: 旋风 + HEPA 两级（全球沙尘暴工况）

specs_en.Dust removal: cyclone + HEPA, two stages (global dust-storm duty)

pois.sim: 吸气量校核：1.5 kg/h ÷ 0.015 kg/m³ ≈ 100 m³/h ✓（修正了设计基准 v1 误写的 1100 m³/h）
pois.sim_en: Intake check: 1.5 kg/h / 0.015 kg/m3 = about 100 m3/h, confirmed (correcting the 1100 m3/h written into design baseline v1).
pois.physics: 理想气体 ρ = pM/RT = 600×0.044/(8.314×210) ≈ 0.015 kg/m³——只有地球海平面空气密度的 1.2%，采集同样质量必须搬运 ~80 倍体积
pois.physics_en: Ideal gas: rho = pM/RT = 600 x 0.044 / (8.314 x 210) = about 0.015 kg/m3 - only 1.2% of sea-level air density on Earth, so collecting the same mass means moving about 80 times the volume.

pois.label: 电解·水回收撬块
pois.detail: PEM 电解堆（13 片双极板叠层，剖切开口可见）把水电解为 H₂ 和 O₂：H₂ 回反应柱构成闭环，O₂ 就是氧化剂产品。反应产物水由右侧卧式冷凝器回收（约占电解进水 45%），差额由 res-rodwell-01 的保温水管从前脸橙色法兰接口补给。屋顶两罐为 H₂/O₂ 气液分离器。
pois.detail_en: A PEM stack (13 bipolar plates, visible through the cutaway) splits water into H2 and O2: the hydrogen returns to the reaction column to close the loop, and the oxygen is itself a product - the oxidiser. Water made by the reaction is recovered in the horizontal condenser on the right, covering about 45% of the feed; the balance arrives through the insulated line from res-rodwell-01 at the orange flange on the front face. The two roof drums are the H2 and O2 gas-liquid separators.
pois.sim: 功率账：0.32 kg/h × 55 kWh/kg ≈ 18 kWe（电解本体），含循环泵/干燥/损耗 ~25 kWe；全厂设计包络 40 kWe 留裕度——电解占全厂功耗大头（§1/§7）
pois.sim_en: Power ledger: 0.32 kg/h x 55 kWh/kg = about 18 kWe for electrolysis itself, and about 25 kWe including circulation pumps, drying and losses. The plant envelope is designed at 40 kWe for margin - electrolysis dominates the site's power draw (sections 1 and 7).
physics: 2H₂O → 2H₂ + O₂，理论电解能 39.4 kWh/kg H₂；PEM 系统级实际 ~55 kWh/kg
氢闭环：Sabatier 产物水回收再电解，氢在厂内循环，系统只净消耗水和 CO₂
physics_en: 2 H2O -> 2 H2 + O2, theoretical 39.4 kWh per kg of H2; a real PEM system runs at about 55 kWh/kg.
Closed hydrogen loop: the water the Sabatier step produces is recovered and re-electrolysed, so hydrogen circulates inside the plant and the only net consumables are water and CO2.

pois.label: 低温储罐 2×LOX + LCH₄
pois.detail: 三个 4 m 球罐：真空夹层外壳悬挂金色 MLI 内胆（近处剖切罐可见），罐顶 RTB 零蒸发冷头+压缩机组。480 sol 无人生产期里任何蒸发损失都直接吃掉产能，因此采用 ZBO 方案——冷头在罐内直接抵消漏热，推进剂零损耗待命。
pois.detail_en: Three 4 m spheres: a vacuum-jacketed shell suspending a gold MLI-wrapped inner vessel (visible in the nearer cutaway tank), with an RTB zero-boil-off cold head and compressor set on top. Across a 480-sol uncrewed production campaign any boil-off comes straight off the delivered total, so a ZBO scheme is used: the cold head cancels the heat leak inside the tank and the propellant waits with zero loss.

specs.任务装载: 30 t 推进剂（23 t LOX + 6.5 t LCH₄）
specs.绝热: 真空夹层 + 多层隔热 MLI
specs.制冷: RTB 逆布雷顿冷头，每罐一台

specs_en.Mission load: 30 t propellant (23 t LOX + 6.5 t LCH4)
specs_en.Refrigeration: RTB reverse-Brayton cold head, one per tank

pois.sim: 容积账：需求 = 23 t LOX ÷ 1141 kg/m³ + 6.5 t LCH₄ ÷ 423 kg/m³ ≈ 35.6 m³；配置 3×33.5 = 100 m³ → 覆盖约 2.5 个 MAV 加注周期，生产不必停机等转运
pois.sim_en: Volume ledger: demand = 23 t LOX / 1141 kg/m3 + 6.5 t LCH4 / 423 kg/m3 = about 35.6 m3; the installed 3 x 33.5 = 100 m3 covers roughly 2.5 MAV fuelling cycles, so production never has to stop and wait for transfer.
physics: 球形是最小表面积/容积比 → 最小漏热面；真空夹层切断传导与对流，MLI 多层反射屏把辐射漏热再压一个量级
ZBO 判据：冷头制冷量 ≥ 罐体总漏热，则蒸发率恒为零
physics_en: A sphere has the smallest surface-to-volume ratio, hence the smallest area to leak heat through. The vacuum jacket cuts conduction and convection, and the MLI radiation shields knock the radiative leak down another order of magnitude.
The ZBO criterion is simply that cold-head lift must equal or exceed total tank heat leak; then the boil-off rate is identically zero.

pois.label: 制冷散热板阵
pois.detail: RTB 制冷机的废热由工质回路（每板背面蛇形盘管+泵撬）送到 4 块黑色辐射板排向天空。火星大气密度不足以对流散热，辐射是唯一出路；板面高发射率涂层，竖直安装减少落尘积累。
pois.detail_en: Waste heat from the RTB refrigerators is carried by a working-fluid loop - serpentine coils on the back of each panel plus a pump skid - out to four black radiator panels that dump it to the sky. The Martian atmosphere is too thin to cool by convection, so radiation is the only route; the panels carry a high-emissivity coating and stand vertical to limit dust settling.

specs.工质回路: 蛇形盘管 + 泵撬 1 台
specs.排热对象: 3 台 RTB 压缩机废热

specs_en.Panels: 4 x 2.5 x 2.3 m = about 23 m2 (one side)

pois.sim: 辐射账：23 m² × 0.52 kW/m² ≈ 12 kW ≥ RTB 废热 ~9 kW（6 kWe 电输入 + 抽取漏热）✓ 闭合，余量应对沙尘降发射率
pois.sim_en: Rejection ledger: 23 m2 x 0.52 kW/m2 = about 12 kW, against RTB waste heat of about 9 kW (6 kWe electrical input plus the extracted heat leak) - closed, with margin left for dust degrading the emissivity.
pois.physics: 斯特藩-玻尔兹曼：P = εσA(T⁴ − T_sky⁴)。板温 330 K 对火星天空 ~200 K，净辐射通量 ≈ 0.52 kW/m²
pois.physics_en: Stefan-Boltzmann: P = eps x sigma x A x (T^4 - T_sky^4). A 330 K panel against a roughly 200 K Mars sky gives a net flux of about 0.52 kW/m2.

pois.label: 安全火炬塔
pois.detail: 常灭安全火炬：反应柱安全阀/爆破片与储罐超压泄放管线汇集于此，顶部防风圈保证 20 m/s 阵风下可靠点火。正常工况完全熄灭无火焰；塔顶红色信标为夜间警示闪烁。
pois.detail_en: A normally unlit safety flare: the reactor's safety valve and rupture disc, together with the tank overpressure relief lines, all vent here, and the wind shield at the top keeps ignition reliable in gusts up to 20 m/s. In normal operation there is no flame at all; the red beacon on top blinks as a night hazard light.
pois.physics: 火星大气无氧、CH₄ 排放本体不燃，但低压下排放气会在洼地缓慢积聚，对携氧的乘员舱/舱外作业构成隐患——受控点燃排放是标准工业安全实践
pois.physics_en: The Martian atmosphere carries no oxygen and vented CH4 will not burn by itself, but at low pressure a release drifts and pools slowly in hollows, which is a hazard to oxygen-bearing crew modules and to EVA work. Controlled ignition of vented gas is standard industrial safety practice.

pois.label: 中控显示屏
pois.detail: 户外 HMI 中控屏：双立柱机柜 + 顶部遮阳檐 + 底部橙色警示条，屏面绘出全厂工艺流程图（吸入→压缩→反应柱→电解→储罐，支线接散热板与火炬），每个单元旁一颗运行灯，火炬为琥珀色待命灯。底部三条液位柱对应三个球罐，右下一行六颗绿灯是电网侧 6 台 Kilopower 在线状态。屏面元素用自发光材质绘制，因此全厂蒙尘、唯独屏是干净发亮的。
pois.detail_en: An outdoor HMI board: a twin-pylon cabinet with a sun visor and an orange hazard stripe at its base. The screen carries the whole plant as a mimic diagram - intake to compressor to reaction column to electrolysis to tanks, with branches to the radiators and the flare - a run lamp beside every unit and an amber standby lamp on the flare. Three level bars at the bottom track the three spheres, and the row of six green lamps at lower right is the grid side: six Kilopower units online. The screen graphics are drawn in self-illuminated material, so while the whole plant wears a film of dust, the display alone stays clean and lit.

specs.画面: 全厂工艺流程 mimic + 单元运行灯
specs.夜间: emit_hmi_screen 自发光，不随昼夜熄灭

specs_en.Cabinet: 4.3 x 2.7 m, twin pylons with sun visor
specs_en.Screen: full-plant mimic diagram + per-unit run lamps

sim: 液位读数与储罐台账自洽：3×33.5 = 100 m³ 装量下，当前 78/52/31% 合计约 54 m³ 推进剂，已过一个 MAV 加注量（35.6 m³）——正处在无人生产期的攒量阶段
绿灯行对应电力账：全城稳态 63 kWe 由 6×10 kWe Kilopower 承担（N+1 冗余，5 台即可撑过夜间稳态），本厂 40 kWe 是其中最大单一负载（EQUIPMENT.md §7）
sim_en: The level readings are consistent with the tank ledger: against an installed 3 x 33.5 = 100 m3, the present 78/52/31% holds about 54 m3 of propellant - already past one MAV load (35.6 m3), i.e. mid-way through the uncrewed accumulation campaign.

The green lamp row matches the power ledger: the city's 63 kWe steady draw is carried by 6 x 10 kWe Kilopower units (N+1 redundancy - five alone cover the night steady state), and this plant's 40 kWe is the single largest load among them (EQUIPMENT.md section 7).
physics: 为什么无人工厂还要一块户外大屏：地火单程光时 4–21 分钟（0.52–2.52 AU），往返 8–42 分钟——地面无法实时遥操，工厂必须自主运行并就地示状态；乘员到达后的舱外检修同样如此，加压手套下敲键盘不现实，能一眼读完的大幅 mimic 板才是 EVA 可用的人机界面
屏面为何是绘制的几何而非发光贴图：火星正午太阳常数约 590 W/m²（地球的 43%），配合遮阳檐，高对比度的实体色块比背光屏更耐眩光，也不怕落尘削弱亮度
physics_en: Why an uncrewed plant still needs a large outdoor board: one-way light time to Earth runs 4-21 minutes (0.52-2.52 AU), 8-42 minutes round trip, so nobody on Earth can teleoperate this plant in real time - it must run autonomously and report its state locally. The same holds once crew arrive: typing on a keyboard in pressurised gloves is not realistic, and a large mimic board readable at a glance is the interface EVA work can actually use.

Why the screen is drawn geometry rather than a glowing texture: the solar constant at Mars is about 590 W/m2 (43% of Earth's), so under the sun visor high-contrast solid blocks of colour beat a backlit panel for glare, and a film of settled dust costs them far less brightness.
